title: finding(plugin-charts): on a data source with no `aggregate()`, `ObjectChart`'s find leg buckets raw records on the group COLUMN, so an `alias` groupBy draws one `Unknown` bar and a `dateGranularity` groupBy draws one bar per raw timestamp
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). A chart draws a picture that is not a picture of the data: the objectui#8168 class. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10634 dev report (PR objectui#10673) and its contract review at `9285295`, which read it at source and called a card owed. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (the review's reading; ⛔ not re-read by the seat)

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`: when the data source has no `aggregate()` (an optional method on `IDataProvider`, `packages/types/src/data.ts`), `ObjectChart` fetches rows with `find` and buckets them client-side in `aggregateRecords`, keyed on `aggregateGroupByKey` (the group COLUMN: `alias || field`).
  - For `groupBy: { field: 'stage', alias: 'phase' }` it reads `record.phase`, which a raw record does not carry, so every row lands in one `Unknown` bucket.
  - For `groupBy: { field: 'closed_at', dateGranularity: 'month' }` it does no date bucketing, so each raw timestamp becomes its own category.
- On the `aggregate()` path, both engine paths name the group column `alias ?? field` and bucket dates server-side, so that path is correct.

## Reach

- Before PR objectui#10673, such a node was refused `missing-category-key`.
- After it, the category forward makes the node draw the mis-bucketed picture.

No in-repo provider lacks `aggregate()` (`data-objectstack` is the only provider package), so no in-repo producer reaches this leg. A host-supplied data source without `aggregate()` does.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Make the find leg bucket as the engine does:
- read the source `field` for the record lookup;
- key the output row by `alias || field`;
- apply `dateGranularity` bucketing with the same boundaries the server uses.

Alternatively, refuse the alias and date forms on the find leg loudly. Pin both forms against the `aggregate()` path as the control. ⛔ Serial: PR objectui#10673 edits `ObjectChart.tsx`; claim this after it merges.

## Dedupe

Regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, matching `aggregateRecords|find leg|alias.*bucket|dateGranularity.*find`: 8 hits, none about this leg (they are kanban lane bucketing, filter-builder operators, and locale dates).

Dedupe words: `ObjectChart find leg alias bucket` · `aggregateRecords alias Unknown` · `dateGranularity client-side bucketing chart` · `no aggregate() data source chart`
